27364.d: The time altar is a runecrafting altar located in the Time Rune Temple, which is used to craft time runes from pure essence with the Runecrafting skill.

gt.heading: Access
gt.text:
As with most other rune temples, it can be accessed via the Abyss. The time rift requires the ruins to be anchored using the enchanted key from Making History or the enchanted key from Meeting History at the time altar.

Players can reach the ruins in any of the following ways:
• The fastest way to get there is through the Abyss with the Nexus Mod relic power and teleporting to Edgeville using the Wilderness sword.
• Up to 92–109 trips an hour can be achieved using this method, or up to 85–100 trips an hour without the Nexus Mod relic power.
• A second way to get there is to use the North-western Anachronia Teleport spell or tablet. Harnessing the Abyssal Link relic power causes the spell to no longer require runes.
• Up to 82–96 trips an hour can be achieved using this method.
• A third way to get there is to cast Anachronia Teleport if the Totem of the Abyss is placed on the totem pedestal on the north side of Anachronia.
• Up to 68–76 trips an hour can be achieved using this method.
• A fourth way to get there is using Orthen teleportation device to the observation outpost and go west, or Crypt of Varanus and go north.
• Up to 48–52 trips an hour can be achieved using this method.
• A fifth way to get there is going from the Anachronia base camp, use the Anachronia Agility Course's beginner northern section (clockwise, requires level 30 Agility) to traverse through the cave and pass the ruined temple, go north through the venomous dinosaurs.
• Up to 40–43 trips an hour can be achieved using this method.

27403.d: Tirannwn (pronunciation TIR-an-un) is the geographical region located west of Kandarin, on the western edge of Gielinor.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• Travel through the Underground Pass, after having started Regicide.
• Teleport to the Tirannwn lodestone.
• Teleport to the Prifddinas lodestone. To enter Isafdar, run directly south and pass the guards. To enter Arandar, run directly east and pass the guards.
• Activate a Crystal teleport seed or Attuned crystal teleport seed. These can take you to Lletya, the Temple of Light, and any of the eight Elven Clan districts of Prifddinas.
• Teleport with the Tirannwn quiver to various locations. Locations include Lletya, Islwyn, Port Tyras, the Poison Waste Slayer Dungeon, the Death altar, the Elf Camp, the Mushroom patch south-west of Tirannwn lodestone, and the Meilyr district of Prifddinas.
• Teleport with the Nature's sentinel outfit. The Magic trees (south Tirannwn) and the Elder trees (west Lletya) will take you to the same location, a few spaces apart.
• Use a Charter ship to Port Tyras. Players must have partial completion of the Regicide quest, up to the point where they kill the Tyras guard, in order to charter a ship here.
• Fairy ring code DLR transports the player to a small island in the Poison Waste. It can be left via a shortcut, requiring partial completion of Plague's End.
• Fairy ring code DJS transports the player to the Amlodd district of Prifddinas. This requires full completion of Plague's End.
• Max guild Teleport, to the Max Guild in the Cadarn district of Prifddinas.
